title: BlueBlocks: Docker & Compose Configurations
description:
Create Docker configurations for BlueBlocks blockchain components.

## Components
- Dockerfile.node - Main HTTP API server (afterblockd daemon)
- Dockerfile.validator - Validator consensus nodes (bblks-validator)
- Dockerfile.miner - Block production miners
- Dockerfile.treasury - Ethereum bridge listener
- Dockerfile.indexer - TimescaleDB block indexer
- Dockerfile.discovery - P2P discovery service

## Docker Compose Files
- docker-compose.devnet.yml - Single-node local development
- docker-compose.testnet.yml - Multi-node test network (3 nodes, 4 validators, 2 miners)

## Features
- Multi-stage builds for small images
- Non-root user security
- Health checks for all services
- Volume mounts for persistence
- Network isolation
